cohort: The study included 30 women: 10 premenopausal women with pelvic organ prolapse, 10 postmenopausal women with pelvic organ prolapse, and 10 premenopausal women without pelvic organ prolapse.
finding: Significant differences were found in LOXL1 mRNA expression between patient groups, with upregulation in the postmenopausal POP group compared to premenopausal POP and premenopausal non-POP groups, suggesting different pathogenic pathways.
cross-section timing: At the time of vaginal biopsy
